acceptanceCriteria.statement: The hosted menu projection presents the normal saved-account shape without claiming live auth, switching, preview rendering, or native menu-bar behavior.
When CodexPill is busy, the hosted menu projection must show the busy status message and disable conflicting immediate actions such as Add Account.
Diagnostics export must present an explicit redacted-support disclosure before building or presenting an export report.
Cancelling the diagnostics disclosure must stop before report export and must not write or present a support artifact.
Confirmed diagnostics export must build only an allowlisted per-export aliased support artifact and must reject or alias sensitive account, host, path, session, auth, and token-like evidence.
If local auth does not match a saved account, CodexPill must not present any saved account as active.
When no accounts are saved, CodexPill must guide the user toward adding an account and must not imply that account switching is possible.

When saved accounts exceed the visible account limit, CodexPill must show the configured visible rows and keep hidden saved accounts discoverable through More Accounts… without changing account submenu behavior.
Empty, whitespace-only, and case-insensitive duplicate Add Account display names must be rejected before CodexPill starts isolated sign-in or browser/device-code work.
Completing isolated Add Account must save the captured account as inactive while preserving the active This Mac account.
When a fake saved-account status client returns usable status after Add Account, CodexPill must apply returned email, plan, and rate-limit metadata to the new inactive account.
Successful isolated Add Account must clean up the isolated login session after capture and verification.
Cancel, auth capture timeout, login verification failure, live-auth mutation, duplicate captured identity, and save failures must clean isolated Add Account state and save no unintended account.
Startup prompt failures must preserve useful sanitized diagnostics without emitting device codes or auth URL query strings.
Stale isolated CODEX_HOME cleanup must remove old CodexPill session directories without deleting fresh sessions or unrelated directories.
Choosing Switch on This Mac must ask for confirmation before activating the selected saved snapshot.
After confirmation, CodexPill must activate the selected saved snapshot, persist account state, relaunch Codex, and run the post-switch active-account refresh path.
Choosing Use on This Mac from Add Account success must route through the existing local switch path without a second confirmation.

features.title: Switch Account remote install and verify

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Remote switch must install the selected saved snapshot before switching when the host reports the account snapshot as missing or stale.
Remote switch must skip installation and switch directly when the host reports the selected saved snapshot as already installed.
After remote auth mutation, CodexPill must refresh the remote Codex app-server and report success only when the remote status verifies the expected account.
When the selected saved account is active on This Mac, CodexPill must relink the saved snapshot from fresher local auth before installing or switching it remotely.

Add Host validation must keep Add Host disabled for idle, testing, invalid, unreachable, SSH-not-ready, and not-Codex-ready destinations, and unlock only after validation succeeds for the same trimmed destination.
Add Host validation must use non-interactive SSH and require Codex CLI, Codex app-server readiness, and writable CodexPill/Codex directories before treating a destination as ready.

features.title: Remote Host install and switch current account

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Confirming the Add Host follow-up must install the current active account when missing, switch the validated host, refresh remote Codex app-server state, verify the expected account, and persist verified host/account state.
Cancelling the Add Host install-current-account follow-up must leave no confusing pending or partially added remote host state.
Failed, unreadable, mismatched, or ambiguous remote verification must clear verified active remote state and must not render the host as a verified active account.
When remote verification detects a different saved account, CodexPill must surface recovery state without replacing the saved account catalog or treating the detected account as verified active.
Remote active account cards must prefer verified remote rate-limit values when those remote windows contain meaningful data.
Remote active account cards must fall back to meaningful saved-account windows only when remote rate-limit data is missing, zeroed, partial, expired, or suspicious.
Saved fallback rate-limit windows must be borrowed from the canonical saved account identity, not from email alone.
Removing an active account must require destructive confirmation before local or remote sign-out and before deleting the saved snapshot.
When the removed account is active on This Mac, CodexPill must sign out local auth and relaunch Codex before deleting the saved snapshot.
When the removed account is active on a connected remote host, CodexPill must sign out that host before deleting the saved snapshot and must stop presenting the removed account as remotely active.
When a required local or remote sign-out fails, CodexPill must keep the saved snapshot and catalog row, preserve the active remote state, and show the real sanitized failure.
Renaming a saved account must change only the CodexPill display label while preserving the saved auth snapshot, Codex identity, plan, and rate-limit data without invoking active-auth mutation.
Empty, whitespace-only, and case-insensitive duplicate rename inputs must be rejected without mutating the account catalog or auth state.
Inactive saved accounts must refresh through isolated saved-account app-server reads without mutating live local Codex auth.
Failed, missing, partial, zeroed, or suspicious inactive saved-account reads must preserve previous meaningful session and weekly rate-limit windows.
Active local refresh must overwrite the matched saved snapshot with current live auth only when the current live identity resolves to the same saved account and the auth fingerprint changed.
Active local refresh must not overwrite saved snapshots when the current live identity is ambiguous or does not match a saved account.
When Token Usage is disabled, CodexPill must not render the Token Usage card in the main active-account area.
When Token Usage is enabled and aggregate data exists, CodexPill must show a compact Last 30 Days card without implying saved-account, workspace, organization, or remote-host usage attribution.

When Token Usage is enabled and no cached aggregate exists, CodexPill must show active loading/progress feedback without fake percentages, raw session details, file paths, account, workspace, organization, or remote-host attribution.

The local Token Usage scanner must parse synthetic Codex token-count rows, handle malformed rows, repeated cumulative totals, large files, and oversized rows safely, and emit aggregate buckets without raw session content or raw local paths.
When cached aggregate data covers the requested Token Usage period, CodexPill must present it before starting scanner work and must not restart scanning for repeated menu/runtime refreshes.
When refreshing a cached selected period, CodexPill must reuse unchanged synthetic file contributions and rescan only new or changed eligible files.

Token Usage diagnostics must expose only aggregate state and totals, and must reject prompt content, raw session rows, local paths, account identifiers, emails, hostnames, auth material, and token-like values.

Preferences must present enabled, disabled, requires-approval, and unavailable Launch at Login states truthfully without implying registration success when macOS reports a blocked or unavailable state.
The closed status item must expose a visible icon and the expected optional text label for synthetic active-account usage state.
